note: Libraries UI is a read-only inspector of Drupal asset libraries. Report at /admin/reports/libraries (route libraries_ui.overview, also the configure route) gated by the permission 'access libraries_ui' (restricted). Controller LibrariesUiController::libraries renders theme hook libraries_ui (templates/libraries-ui.html.twig) with LibrariesUiService::getAllLibraries() (service id libraries_ui) which returns an array keyed extension->library->definition via core library.discovery. Drush: libraries:debug (alias ld). It has no config entity or storage. Because it has no config of its own, medium/hard cases are grounded in the real access-control config it introduces: the 'access libraries_ui' permission on user.role.* config entities (namespaced roles created/inspected by the scripts).

evals.prompt: The Libraries UI Drupal module adds an admin page that lists all asset (CSS/JS) libraries on the site. What is the URL/path of that report, and which permission controls access to it?
evals.expected_output: The report is at /admin/reports/libraries (route libraries_ui.overview, under Reports) and is gated by the 'access libraries_ui' permission.

evals.prompt: Does the Libraries UI module provide a Drush command to list libraries from the command line? If so, what is it and its alias?
evals.expected_output: Yes: drush libraries:debug (alias ld). It shows an interactive extension picker and prints a Name/Version/Dependencies table using LibrariesUiService::getAllLibraries().

evals.prompt: In custom code, how can I get all asset library metadata that the Libraries UI module collects, as a PHP array? Name the service and method and describe the array's shape.
evals.expected_output: Call \Drupal::service('libraries_ui')->getAllLibraries() (Drupal\libraries_ui\LibrariesUiService). It returns a nested array keyed by extension (including 'core') -> library name -> the core library definition (version, css, js, dependencies, ...).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one role has been granted permission to view the Libraries UI report (the 'access libraries_ui' permission). Inspect the live role configuration and give the machine id of that role.
evals.expected_output: The role is libraries_ui_auditor: its user.role config grants the 'access libraries_ui' permission.

evals.prompt: This site has two roles, libraries_ui_allowed and libraries_ui_denied. Only one of them can open the Libraries UI report at /admin/reports/libraries. Inspect the live permissions configuration and state which role can.
evals.expected_output: libraries_ui_allowed can view the report because it holds the 'access libraries_ui' permission; libraries_ui_denied does not.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a role with machine id 'libraries_ui_task_role'. Grant it the Libraries UI permission so members can open the Libraries report at /admin/reports/libraries. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'access libraries_ui' permission to the libraries_ui_task_role role (e.g. drush role:perm:add libraries_ui_task_role 'access libraries_ui', or tick it on the Permissions page).

evals.prompt: I have a user group called 'libraries_ui_task_role' on my site. I want people in that group to be able to see the page that lists all the libraries/assets on my site. Please give that group the access it needs.
evals.expected_output: Same end state as the expert phrasing: the libraries_ui_task_role role is granted the 'access libraries_ui' permission (the permission Libraries UI uses to gate /admin/reports/libraries).
